title: send-log.json
description: Per-config ATTEMPT-level send log (DECISIONS-M0 §6), at data/batches/<batch>/configs/<config_id>/send-log.json. Records every send attempt behind each slot POSITION — the detail meta.json's terminal state summarizes. Ruling model (DECISIONS-M0 §6): a slot is a POSITION; a slot is FILLED by the request that reached the model; unreachable / rate-limited retries are non-slot-consuming (do NOT consume cost / are not samples) but MULTIPLE such attempts precede a position's terminal state — that per-attempt history (429 / quota / not-sent tries, backoff, whether each reached the model) lives here, not in meta.json. Explains both successful slot fills and the rate-limited-exhausted / unreachable UNFILLED positions. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme fixes the terminal-state SEMANTICS (§1.1) but not the attempt-log JSON shape; the layout is this contract's design (DECISIONS-M0 §6). Timestamps/durations are OBSERVATIONAL and excluded from any verify hash (scheme §0). schema_version 1.0.0; file SHA256 + version frozen into lock (scheme §11).
$comment: schema_version: 1.0.0. FLAG (scheme-silent, pre-existing): the frozen layout's slots/<k>/ directory does not encode the P-min/P-q variant dimension, yet each config × variant has its own N positions (scheme §1.1/§1.2 blocks each run one P-min + one P-q). This log makes (variant, slot_index) EXPLICIT per position; the meta.json/slots directory variant dimension remains under-specified in DATA-LAYOUT and is flagged for the owner. attempt.outcome is the per-attempt classification (6 values, 'rate-limited' un-suffixed); terminal_state is the slot-meta 6-state enum ('rate-limited-exhausted' after the backoff budget is spent).

config_id.description: Config id; equals the parent <config_id> directory and is in manifest.config_ids.

N.description: Slots per config per variant (== manifest.N).

retry_policy.description: Frozen batch-wide retry budgets (scheme §1.1). Recorded for auditability of exhaustion terminals.

max_unreachable_retries.description: '未发送重试上限 5' (scheme §1.1 / appendix A). Exhaustion → terminal unreachable.

rate_limit_backoff.description: Rate-limited exponential-backoff budget, frozen pre-batch (scheme §1.1: 次数上限 + 总时长上限). Exhaustion → terminal rate-limited-exhausted.

max_attempts.description: Max rate-limited retry attempts before exhaustion.

max_total_ms.description: Max cumulative backoff wall time (ms) before exhaustion.

positions.description: One entry per slot POSITION = (variant, slot_index). There are N positions per variant. (variant,slot_index) composite uniqueness is runner-enforced.

slot_index.description: Position index k=0..N-1; matches slots/<k>/ and meta.json.slot_index. Required for ALL terminal states (DECISIONS-M0 §6).

block_index.description: Time block 0..N-1 this position belongs to (scheme §1.2 pairing randomization; the block runs one P-min + one P-q).

terminal_state.description: Final terminal state of the position (slot-meta 6-state enum, scheme §1.1). unreachable / rate-limited-exhausted = UNFILLED position (no model-reaching attempt succeeded).

model_reaching_attempt_index.description: attempt_index of the single attempt that reached the model and set the terminal state (for valid / model-failed / infra-failed / acceptance-unknown); null for the two UNFILLED terminals (no attempt reached the model).

attempts.description: Every send attempt for this position in chronological order (attempt_index ascending). The last attempt determines terminal_state. Non-slot-consuming (unreachable / rate-limited) attempts may precede the terminal one.

outcome.description: Per-attempt classification. valid/model-failed/infra-failed/acceptance-unknown = reached the model (a filled outcome). unreachable = provably not sent. rate-limited = provably-uncharged pre-model refusal (this attempt); the position becomes rate-limited-exhausted only when the backoff budget is spent.

reached_model.description: true iff this attempt was delivered to the model (the four filled outcomes); false for unreachable / rate-limited. This is the cost/sample boundary (scheme §1.1).

charged.description: true = provably billed; false = provably uncharged (unreachable, rate-limited with a deterministic 429/quota/503 signal); null = unprovable (acceptance-unknown — conservatively may have billed).

reason.description: Versioned finer-grained reason. unreachable → connection-refused/dns-failure/tls-failure; rate-limited → http-429/quota-exceeded/http-503-overloaded (the deterministic uncharged evidence required by scheme §1.1); infra-failed → mid-stream-death; acceptance-unknown → pre-header-timeout; model-failed → no-valid-html/refusal/self-truncated; valid → ok; or null.

http_status.description: HTTP status if one was received (e.g. 429, 503), else null (e.g. connection refused before any response).

backoff_ms.description: Backoff wall time (ms) applied before the NEXT attempt (rate-limited exponential backoff), or null when no backoff followed.

request_id.description: Vendor request id / response-header evidence, if present. Its presence distinguishes infra-failed / acceptance-unknown (scheme §1.1).

started_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC attempt start. OBSERVATIONAL — excluded from every verify hash (scheme §0).

ended_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC attempt end. OBSERVATIONAL — excluded from verify hashes.
